info.title: sqlbranch
info.description: Writable, full-size SQL Server database branches in seconds, for development, tests and AI agents.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: SqlBranch: writable, full-size SQL Server database branches in seconds.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: text or json. [default: Text]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Print only the essential result. [default: False]

options.name: --config
options.description: Use this file instead of the repository's .sqlbranch.yml.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Create the pool and the engine, or check that they are running. Safe to repeat.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check Docker, the engine image, the pool, the port, free space, the host and optional SqlPackage. Works before init.

options.name: --sqlpackage
options.description: Path to SqlPackage. Defaults to searching PATH.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show the engine, the pool and anything that does not match. Exits 1 when it lists a mismatch.

commands.name: engine
commands.description: Start or stop the engine container.

commands.name: start
commands.description: Start the engine and wait until it accepts connections.

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Stop the engine. Safe to repeat.

commands.name: teardown
commands.description: Remove the engine, every image and branch, every other database on the engine and the pool SqlBranch created. Needs --force.

options.name: --force
options.description: Confirm that the engine, every image and branch, and the pool are to be removed. [default: False]

commands.name: image
commands.description: Build, list and remove images: sealed, read-only database files that branches are cloned from.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Build an image from a backup, SQL scripts or a BACPAC.

options.name: --from-bacpac
options.description: Build from a local BACPAC or an Azure Blob or S3 URL.

options.name: --sqlpackage
options.description: Path to SqlPackage for a BACPAC build. Defaults to searching PATH.

options.name: --from-bak
options.description: The full database backup to build the image from: a file, an https:// Azure Blob URL or an s3:// URL.

options.name: --s3-region
options.description: The region of an s3:// URL. Default us-east-1.

options.name: --from-scripts
options.description: Build from the SQL files in this folder.

options.name: --post-script
options.description: Run this SQL script before sealing. May be repeated.

options.name: --script-timeout
options.description: Maximum time per script in minutes, hours or days.

options.name: --backup-set
options.description: Which backup set of the file to use. [default: 1]

options.name: --keep-recovery-model
options.description: Do not switch the image's database to the SIMPLE recovery model. [default: False]

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The image name: 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the images with their source database, size, build time and the number of branches created from each.

commands.name: export
commands.description: Write an image, its manifest and a SHA-256 for each file, as one compressed archive.

options.name: --to
options.description: Where to write the archive: a file, an https:// Azure Blob URL or an s3:// URL. A file ends in .sbimg by convention.

options.name: --s3-region
options.description: The region of an s3:// URL. Default us-east-1.

options.name: --force
options.description: Replace the destination when it already exists. The old file is kept until the new archive is complete. [default: False]

commands.name: import
commands.description: Add the image inside an archive written by 'image export' to the pool.

options.name: --as
options.description: The name for the imported image. Default: the name inside the archive.

options.name: --s3-region
options.description: The region of an s3:// URL. Default us-east-1.

arguments.name: SOURCE
arguments.description: The archive to import: a file, an https:// Azure Blob URL or an s3:// URL.

commands.name: rm
commands.description: Remove an image. Branch files are never touched.

options.name: --force
options.description: Remove the image even when branches were created from it. They keep working, but cannot be reset. [default: False]

commands.name: branch
commands.description: Create, list, reset and remove branches: writable databases cloned from an image.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a branch: a writable database holding the image's data.

options.name: --from
options.description: The image to clone the branch from. Without it, the defaultImage setting is used.

options.name: --copy
options.description: Make full copies of the image's files even when the pool can share blocks, for benchmarks. [default: False]

options.name: --ephemeral
options.description: Mark the branch for removal after its time limit. [default: False]

options.name: --ttl
options.description: Time limit in minutes, hours or days (default 1h).

options.name: --label
options.description: Set a key=value label. May be repeated.

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The branch name, which is also its database name: 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the branches with their image, clone mode, creation time, state and the space their own changed data uses.

options.name: --label
options.description: Show branches matching every key=value label.

commands.name: prune
commands.description: Remove expired short-lived branches.

commands.name: conn
commands.description: Print the connection string of a branch. It contains the engine password: this is the only command whose output does.

commands.name: reset
commands.description: Return a branch to the exact state of its image, keeping its name and connection string.

commands.name: rm
commands.description: Remove a branch: close its connections, drop its database and delete its files.

commands.name: skill
commands.description: Install the SqlBranch coding-agent skill into a project.

commands.name: export
commands.description: Write the generated skill and its command references.

options.name: --dir
options.description: Destination skill directory.

options.name: --force
options.description: Replace existing generated files. [default: False]
